pool.text: Ẹwuare changed the name of the state to Ẹdo in Benin City.
The Portuguese visited Benin City around the year fourteen eighty-five.
A British Naval officer visited Benin city and wrote about its walls.
Benin City fell to the British on seventeenth February.
Alan Boisragon included references to human sacrifice in a firsthand account.
The British permitted the restoration of the Benin monarchy in Nigeria.
Benin City became the capital of Mid-Western Region in June.
The region was renamed Bendel State while remaining the capital.
The Queen Idia mask was used as a festival mascot.
It became the State Capital of Edo State after division.
A published study highlighted waste management standards set by the board.
